t: John Carmack's keynote at Quakecon 2013 part 4

q.x: What you describe above is similar to what Carmack discussed at his QuakeCon keynote several years back when toying with a game engine on Haskell. Very interesting talk, [link]

desc:
Some of the things Carmack talks about in this video:
- OpenGL
- functional programming
- Haskell
- Lisp
- Scheme
- strong and weak typing
- multithreading
- events
- garbage collection
- QuakeC vs Scheme

Part 1:
new console cycle
AMD hardware
game controllers

Part 2:
Kinnect
Digital distribution
Portable consoles
Andriod and iOS
Cloud gaming
Creative vision vs technology
Unified memory
PowerVR
